title: merge.sh and main-health.sh
acceptance: merge.sh acquires the merge lock, rebases the branch onto main, re-runs verify.sh, squash-merges, and releases the lock on every exit path
A failed post-rebase verify aborts the landing and returns the task to the implementer rather than merging
merge.sh is the mechanism, not the authority: it runs only when the overseer instructs an agent to land
main-health.sh runs verify.sh against a clean checkout of main and reports a single exit code
Locks are atomic, record a pid, and are reclaimable after a configurable stale timeout

history.detail: merge lock, rebase, post-rebase re-verify, PR path when auto_merge is off; health cached by main SHA
PR path removed. Landing is now an overseer instruction executed by the implementing agent via merge.sh; auto_merge replaced by land_requires_human.
